description: Independently reproducible offline Lua 5.1.4 parser and synthetic-fixture validation of the staged SC-103 LuaPad hover-probe materials.
status_comment: All three staged files parse with Lua 5.1.4 and the offline fixture returns exactly 454 successes; no physical RIFT runtime claim.

environment.vendor_patch_note: luaconf.h unconditionally defines LUA_BUILD_AS_DLL and LNUM_INT64; interpreter self-identifies as Lua 5.1.4 (double int64). This is not proven identical to RIFT's embedded Lua.

build.compilation_mode: MSVC /nologo /W3 /O2 /MD /LD /DLUA_CORE /DLUA_LIB, 29 config.mak C units plus lnum.c; link lua51.dll and lua51.lib; compile standalone lua.c against import library.
build.excluded_file_comment: No LUA_USER_H and no lua_user.c to avoid the optional Win32 locking hook and its MessageBox code; no vendor source edits.
build.stderr_comment: MSVC emitted legacy source warnings (CRT deprecations and macro redefinitions); compilation and linking completed successfully.

tests.assertion: loadfile() succeeds for all three staged Lua files without executing them

failed_preliminaries.note: A complex cmd.exe /s /c literal-argument launch failed before compilation; replaced by a hash-pinned script in the ignored output directory.
Running the fixture from the output directory could not resolve relative tools/ paths; rerunning from the repository root succeeded.

verified: Three staged files parse under this interpreter
Synthetic SC-103 fixture passes exactly 454 checks
not_verified: RIFT embedded Lua ABI or runtime equivalence
Live Inspect.Tooltip and event attach/detach behavior
Any stable or authoritative Legendary selection ID
Physical game integration, role selection, casting, or UI interactions
qualification_boundary.next_gate: Operator-approved, live SC-103 hover run when physical RIFT is active; correlate source and captured output without promoting candidate ID to selector prematurely.

provenance_comment: Git-tracked source files and source-hash-pinned evidence retained; compilation artifacts and build.cmd live only under Git-ignored artifacts/.
